title: Open-Meteo historical archive — Chicago 41.8781N 87.6298W, 4–12 October 2026
claims: The query returns nine daily records from 4 to 12 October 2026 for a grid point at 41.862915N, 87.64877W, elevation 241 m, timezone America/Chicago.
Daily maximum temperature across the nine days ranges from 18.6°C to 28.9°C, with a median of 22.1°C.
Daily minimum temperature across the nine days ranges from 10.6°C to 16.6°C, with a median of 11.9°C.
Two of the nine days record 0.4 mm of precipitation, on 9 and 12 October 2026, and no day reaches 1 mm.
On race day, 11 October 2026, the grid point records a maximum of 22.1°C, a minimum of 13.6°C, 0.0 mm precipitation and maximum wind of 11.3 km/h.
Daily maximum wind across the nine days ranges from 11.3 to 21.8 km/h, with a median of 14.5 km/h.
The values are modelled historical data for a grid point, not measurements on the race course.
